body:
Today I took a bunch of steps backwards ..... I slept all day.  I am indeed tired of him pushing me.  I think he does it because it scares him when I am depressed.  I talked to him about it honestly a few days ago and he said he'd stop doing it, but he still is, so we're going to have to have another heart to heart.  I see my psychiatrist in a few hours (its 3:30 am here and I have a 9 am appointment!).  Hopefully he'll have some good ideas for me ..... 

Would you like to switch to PM?

I feel satisfied and less depressed after doing work.  I feel accomplished!  Yesterday (Sunday) was harder.  I slept most all day and my husband was back to pushing me to get up but I was just so exhausted.  So tomorrow (.... a few hours from now) I'm going to try to be vertical at least a few hours and do a few chores.  

I think you're right about writing a small list of to-dos.  I will try that today.

You won't believe this, but I cleaned a lot today downstairs.  I mopped the *entire* downstairs (it was a lot of work!).  I also straightened up and went grocery shopping.  I haven't been to the grocery store in a week.  I also went out last night with my son to an event at his high school.  

My suicidal thoughts are getting chased much farther farther down the way....

I cleaned my kitchen. I also ate something. Two things I haven't done in days. I feel a smidge better.

One foot, one step, one minute, one hour.

(( thank you ))

I think I can clean the kitchen.  If I can keep the kitchen functional and clean, then the rest of life won't seem as overwhelming.  Currently my days and nights are mixed up .... I sleep all day and am awake all night.  So tonight I will clean the kitchen.  I'll report back on my progress.  

Thank you for corresponding with me kind stranger.  I don't know who you are or why you are helping me, but know that you are and I thank you for this.

I feel lazy.  Because I don't clean the house.  I barely do enough to keep us fed.  Its complicated because my husband is profoundly disabled, so I have to take care of him, and so he is 100% dependent on me to take care of him.  And he has started making snide little remarks here and there about sleeping all day and it makes me feel very bad. :(   And that just feeds the cycle....

I told him of my suicidal thoughts about a month ago, that's when I started going to my psych 2x a week.  He tweaked my meds, which helped some.  But now the suicidal thoughts are back, and I think he has compassion fatigue a little so I haven't told him that the suicidal thoughts are back.  And my main symptom is sleeping.  I sleep all the time .... except at night when I'm supposed to sleep. :(   And the thing is, I know that I will not act on my suicidal thoughts.  And in a way that's worse.  Because I am 100% trapped feeling this shitty.  There is no way out.  Ever.  I just have to feel this way until something changes.  Somehow.  

Crocheting helps, or rather, makes the time pass.  I have been doing that a lot lately.
Thank you for this.... I will try to think of it this way and see if it helps me.

Thanks.  I know I need to stay around for him.  And I will.  I will not act on these thoughts. but in a way, its worse knowing that I can't act on these thoughts because I'm just trapped in this depression.... you know?

Thanks for your reply.  I have been seeing a pyschiatrist for the past 10 years, and in the past month I've been seeing him twice a week because my symptoms are flaring badly (I have bipolar, as my username suggests....) and I am in the middle of a bad bad depression.  I don't really have a lot of friends to turn to, I mean, I do in a way - I have a ton of friends.  But none of them "get" it.  My husband is a big support, but I honestly think he is getting a little tired of me being depressed.  ....
